mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 3.0%) indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing the cost of capital and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 5.0%) signals strong labor market conditions that sustain consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE < 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST > 0.5% monthly) and retail sales (RSAFS > 0.5% monthly) indicates robust consumer demand, accelerating corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS exceed 0.5% monthly growth.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rises > 0.2% in 3 months), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 0.3% monthly growth) signals economic contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.2% in 3 months and INDPRO < 0.3% monthly growth.

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production growth (INDPRO > 0.5% monthly) reflects robust manufacturing activity, supporting corporate profit margins and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO > 0.5% monthly growth.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate (GDPC1) above 3.0% (annualized) indicates sustained economic expansion, increasing corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when GDPC1 growth rate exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 6.0%), a decline in employment growth (PAYEMS < 0.0% monthly) signals labor market deterioration, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE > 6.0% and PAYEMS < 0.0% monthly growth.

mechanism_narrative: A low inflation rate (CPIAUCSL < 2.0% annualized) indicates stable price levels, reducing real interest rate uncertainty and supporting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL < 2.0% annualized.
